EC1: 1. History of anti-cancer therapy for MBC（with the exception of one prior hormonal regimen for MBC）.
EC2: 2. History of HER tyrosine kinase inhibitors [OR] or monoclonal antibody for breast cancer in any treatment setting，except trastuzumab used in the neo-adjuvant [OR] or adjuvant setting.
EC3: 3. Assessed by the investigator to be [NOT] unable receive systemic chemotherapy.
EC4: 4. History of other malignancy within the last 5 years，except for carcinoma in situ of cervix，basal cell carcinoma [OR] or squamous cell carcinoma of the skin that has been previously treated with curative intent.
EC5: 5. Pregnant [OR] or lactating women， [OR] or for women of childbearing potential [NOT] unwilling to use a highly-effective contraception during of the study treatment [AND] and for at least 7 months after the last dose of study treatment.
